The gameplay itself is really fun. Every bullet that hits, you can feel. Every Stratagem you let loose on the enemy, you can see the havoc it creates. It is just cathartic, fun and chaotic at the same time. The higher the difficulty, the better you must become and the more you have to coordinate. But even if you play without a mic, the game still provides all the queues required for teammates to know what you are doing. Even playing with randoms has been an absolute blast!

There are dozens of strategems, upgrades, weapons, armor and more to unlock, and there will be more coming, hopefully! This is indeed the aspect of the game that keeps the loop interesting and new, as you play with different loadouts adjusted to your current team or playstyle. And yes, there are microtransactions to buy much of this, however you can find the ingame currency in missions to some extent. I am not a fan of microtransactions but at least at this point they are not predatory whatsoever and considering that future content will be free and the game does imply a live service, I find it an okay approach to fund the game.

The game environment is gorgeous and I find myself captured in its world. The comedy is always there, there are hilarious and epic moments and in general, it is just a really really good mix of grand battles and laughter.

Immediate first impressions: wow! Helldivers 2 feels great to play. The bugs are fun to shoot and the bots are menacing and fun to blow apart. I can't speak to the larger meta-progression yet, but the hooks are absolutely there for me to keep coming back to spread more super democracy for Super Earth.

I have played all of arrowheads games across the years, As I stepped into the chaotic universe of Helldivers 2, I was immediately struck by its bold transformation. The sequel deftly shifts from the original’s top-down view to a thrilling third-person perspective, and let me tell you, it works like a charm! Here’s why this game has me grinning from ear to ear:

Imagine the over-the-top gore and patriotic pageantry of Starship Troopers infused with a dash of absurdity. That’s Helldivers 2 for you! The comedic tone is outrageously delightful. It’s like a B-movie extravaganza where freedom fighters battle alien bugs while cracking jokes.it is a fun universe and its great solo but so much better in co-op with a bunch of friends.

The transition to third-person view brings us closer to the action, it’s exhilarating! Whether I’m mowing down people on my my own team as they runaway from a bug and into my line of fire (oops!) no harm done just mini game that arrow pattern and boom everyone is back to blasting, or working closely with a team mate to ensure we have a location locked down and we each have our defined roles of long range short range, call a bombardment in to the north, can you call in a resupply, can you watch my back while I reload my machine gun, its just fun and constant frenetic action, each mission on the harder difficulty levels is on a razors edge between total success and victory or utter defeat. 

you have a deep roster of gadgets. Need to keep an area clear? Deploy a turret. Craving cover? Throw down a bubble shield. Communication and teamwork are vital—unlocking new toys ensures survival.

The strategems system is genius. the cinematic explosions at night as you run away from a horde of bugs you just called an airstrike on, the fact that you can see the pod eject from the capital ship above and then burn its way down to the surface, with much needed supplies, a power weapon or just a handy auto turret.

if you are on the fence give it a try, I came out after my first session and could not believe I had been playing for 3 hrs already, its just fun chaos, everything is well thought out and even the little details have a lot of care and attention to make the whole package feel very polished and immersive, I love my time with the game so far and I expect to play a lot more as my friends sign on for duty.

If you're experiencing constant crashes (especially on AMD GPU), try the following:

Add the following to your Helldivers2 Steam launch parameters: "--use-d3d11". 
This disables Directx12 and forces the game to run in dx11. 
For good measure you can also navigate to and delete the contents of %APPDATA%\Arrowhead\Helldivers2\shader_cache. 
The shader_cache folder only contains the dx12 cache, no important files.

A very fun game with great gunplay, on the lower difficulties gunplay is all you need and feels very satisfying on the higher difficulties with multiple friends things start to get wild as you use your abilities/stratagems to you advantage, the difficulty can be punishing and the fights can get chaotic and brutal but fortunately your given plenty of respawns/reinforcements.

The game has a lot going on in terms of effects and lighting and foliage, despite this the game looks very pretty and runs really well.

I never played hell divers 1 and don't really know much about story or lore, but Helldivers 2 looks like it wouldn't be far removed from the original starship troopers film, the setting is overly cheesy blind patriotic propaganda as you solo or with three others run around with main objectives on the map and secondary ones hidden around for bonus experience in game currencies and even the chance of finding the premium currency.

Game had issues early on with matchmaking not being able to connect to the quick join mechanic but friends were still able to join me, a day one patch seems to of already fixed that issue however.

If I was to criticise anything about the game it might be the warbond system, this is like a battle pass system and there is a premium warbond tree aswell which for the most gives you different skinned items a little earlier than what you would obtain on the normal warbond tree. I didnt pay for the premium access and was doing just as good as friends who did.

I'm not sure what the future holds for the warbond system especially is premium version but i have never really been a fan of battlepass systems.

All in all though standing on its own merits I think this is a really good game, Solo you can take your time patrol around small maps fighting off bugs completing small mission objectives or join a squad of randoms or friends as things go wild with a nice variety of enemies and objectives to complete.

Edit: after 30 hours of play I unlocked the "Premium warbond" battlepass just from finding the special credits in game , with so little that took my interest on the Special credit store it just piled up, with the knowledge, experience and a bit of luck I could probably of achieved the same result in 20 - 25 hours tops.
